subject: Renewal discussion: VPC isolation + additional clusters for AVA Data

Subject: Renewal discussion: capacity & VPC options for AVA Data

Hi Evan —

Quick note as we approach your contract renewal (Dec 15): thanks again for running Redwood in-prod for the last 10 months. Based on your current consumption and upcoming pilot workloads, I put together a short proposal with two options:

- Option A: 24-month renewal with +2 dedicated clusters (same region, shared control plane) — includes 6% committed discount.
- Option B: 24-month renewal + Dedicated VPC deployment (private control plane + new isolated clusters) — larger uplift, includes SOC2 attestation and private network support.

Attached is a proposal that sketches pricing and timelines. If you want isolation for dev/staging/prod (one cluster per environment) we can size that and add staging migrations.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Tell me which option you prefer (A/B) or if you want a hybrid.
2) If Option B, I'll loop in Neha (AM) and Marcus (solutions) to scope VPC networking and lead time.

[Attachment: Redwood-Proposal-AVA-20261101.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min call this week.

Best,
Rishi

Rishi —

Thanks for the proposal. A few clarifying items from our side before we commit:

- We want strict isolation for prod. Ideally a private VPC deployment with dedicated clusters so data plane traffic never traverses shared infrastructure. Can you confirm if Option B delivers that, and whether we get separate clusters for dev/staging/prod?
- What is the expected lead time to spin up two additional prod-grade clusters in our region? We have a compliance window starting Jan 10 and would need production capacity by then.
- Please attach SOC2 Type II evidence and any network diagrams we can share with our security team.
- On pricing: if we commit to 24 months with the VPC option, what is the uplift per committed GPU hour (and what is the monthly committed minimum)?

Cc'd procurement to loop them in early.

Thanks,

Neha / Marcus —

Forwarding Evan's reply. AVA wants strict prod isolation (VPC + dedicated clusters for prod) and two additional prod clusters by Jan 10. Can you help with:

- Marcus: quick sizing estimate for 2x prod clusters (specs below), lead time, migration window, and network requirements (VPC peering, private endpoints, firewall rules). Also please confirm whether we can deliver now vs. phased (canary followed by full cutover).
- Neha: commercial impact — uplift % and monthly minimum for 24-month commit. Also let me know if we can offer any credit / accelerated provisioning for an early signature.

Quick sizing notes from AVA (per their telemetry): ~2M tokens/day, burst to 8 concurrent heavy sessions, prefer A100-class equivalent perf.

Thanks — please draft a short note I can send Evan with the updated terms and timeline.

Rishi

Rishi / Neha —

Summary: we can support an isolated VPC deployment with three clusters (dev/stage/prod) where prod is fully dedicated and network-segmented. High-level notes:

- Prod cluster sizing (per cluster): 8x A100-equivalent GPUs, 512GB GPU RAM pool, 5TB NVMe cache.
- Lead time: 4 weeks to provision bare cluster capacity + 1 week for network & firewall coordination (total ~5 weeks). For a Dec 15 renewal our Jan 10 target is tight but feasible if provisioning starts immediately and procurement signs by Nov 21.
- Canary migration: recommend staged rollout (1 prod cluster in week 1, traffic shift over 48h, then remaining cluster next week).
- Network: we’ll provide a VPC peering guide and private endpoint configuration. Need AVA to open the following ports and provide CIDR blocks. I uploaded a sketch.

[Attachment: vpc-architecture-sketch.png (PNG, 230KB)]

Edge cases & requirements:
- Backup isolation: nightly encrypted backups to AVA-managed bucket (customer-supplied KMS) — OK.
- Logs & audit: we can deliver per-tenant audit logs for prod clusters retained 90 days (longer retention available as add-on).

I’ll prepare a concise technical appendix for Evan — Neha, once you confirm commercials I can estimate a firm provisioning SLA.

Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
